# Axial Skyrmions  
- The relative phase definition of axial Skyrmions in this paper differs from that in prior works ([3, 12, 7]) by an additional π because it changes the sign of only one pion field, unlike the antiSkyrmion definition where all three pion fields change sign.  
- The adopted definition aligns more naturally with comparisons to analogous monopole configurations.  
- Equation (3.10) describes a profile function with a zero value at a radius \(s/2\) from the Skyrmion or antiSkyrmion center, ensuring smooth continuity of Skyrmion and antiSkyrmion patches, with fields outside their cores set to the vacuum.  
- Both simple initial conditions from ansatz (3.7) and advanced configurations based on the rational map ansatz [11] with axially symmetric charge \(n\) maps were explored.
